fundamentals.business_description: Bank of Montreal provides diversified financial services primarily in North America. It operates through Canadian P&C, U.S. P&C, BMO Wealth Management, and BMO Capital Markets segments. BMO is Canada's third-largest bank by assets and has a significant presence in the U.S. Midwest through its BMO Harris Bank subsidiary.

latest_analysis.executive_summary: Bank of Montreal offers moderate value at current levels but earnings momentum remains unclear as the US banking integration progresses. A neutral stance is warranted until the next earnings cycle provides clearer direction on PCL trends and US segment profitability.
key_drivers: US Midwest banking franchise growing but integration costs ongoing
PCL normalization largely complete — credit quality stabilizing
Dividend yield well-covered but limited growth expected near-term

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: Not a priority addition — portfolio already has sufficient Financials exposure through RY.TO. Monitor for a more decisive earnings catalyst.
layer2_context.suggested_action: Watch and wait — revisit after Q2 earnings
